title: Vertiv expansion plans to create up to 300 jobs in Donegal
description: Recent reports indicate that Vertiv is planning an expansion that could result in the creation of up to 300 new positions in the north west.

sections.heading: Job Creation Plans
paragraphs: According to RTE.ie, Vertiv is set to create 300 jobs in the north west. The Irish Times reports that Vertiv plans a Donegal expansion creating up to 300 jobs. Similarly, Donegal Daily states that up to 300 new jobs are planned with a major Vertiv Letterkenny expansion.

sections.heading: Location of Expansion
paragraphs: The expansion is focused on the north west region according to RTE.ie. Specifically, The Irish Times mentions the expansion is in Donegal. Donegal Daily specifies the location as Letterkenny.
